description: Generate OPC UA NodeSet2.xml and the symbols CSV from a YAML model. Requires an API key (set OPCUA_MODELER_API_KEY env var). NodeIds stay stable only if each regeneration passes back the symbols of the previous one: pass symbols_csv, or mode "new" for a first generation, or mode "renumber" to change ids on purpose. A call with none of these is refused with SYMBOLS_DECISION_REQUIRED. Returns base64-encoded artifacts if the model is valid. The result lists symbol counts (reused/new/dropped), hints and next steps.

include_docs.description: Set to true to include markdown documentation (slower)

mode.description: "new": first generation, no symbols yet. "update": regeneration, symbols required. "renumber": allocate new NodeIds on purpose. Omit when passing symbols.

symbols_csv.description: The symbols CSV of the previous generation (the content of <name>.model.symbols.csv, or the base64 symbols_csv a previous call returned). Keeps NodeIds stable.

yaml.description: The full YAML model source to generate from

name: opcua_model_generate
title: Generate NodeSet2 XML
